name: Ghibrani Sky Patrol (CR 1/2)
body:
GHIBRANI SKY PATROL
CR 1/2

This beetle-like humanoid has a mottled brown exoskeleton. A pair of slender wings lie folded across its back, and it holds a heavy crossbow.

XP 200
Ghibrani operative 1
LN Medium humanoid (ghibrani)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 armor)
hp 9 (1d8+1)
Fort +0, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (clumsy)
Melee shortsword +3 (1d6 P, 19-20/×2)
Ranged pistol +3 (1d8/x4 B&P, range incr. 20 ft., misfire 1, capacity 1; AP 3)
Special Attacks sneak attack +1d6

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 17, Con 11, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 8
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 13
Feats Amateur Gunslinger, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +7, Climb +4, Diplomacy +5, Disable Device +7, Fly -4, Knowledge (local) +7, Perception +6, Sense Motive +6, Stealth +7, Survival +7; Species Modifiers +2 Diplomacy
Languages Common, Ghibrani, 2 others
SQ cooperative, deeds (quick clear), grit pool (max. 1 point), specialization (explorer), subspecies (hiveship ghibrani)
Gear NPC gear (leather armor, pistol with 10 alchemical cartridges, shortsword, thieves’ tools, other gear)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cooperative (Ex)

A hiveship ghibrani gains a +2 bonus to skill checks for the aid another action and to attack rolls to provide covering fire or harrying fire. A creature using the aid another action to assist a hiveship ghibrani with a skill check gains a +2 bonus to their skill check.

ABOUT

Unlike the husk and membrane varieties of their species, hiveship ghibrani fled their planet when it experienced its cataclysm, eventually colonizing new worlds. Living together on these hiveships caused them to become a closeknit people dedicated to the survival of the community. The sky patrol serve to protect the perimeter of their settlements. They are clumsy flyers, so they usually land before engaging with intruders.
